review:
A tiny 3x3 Irish-luck game with five lines and one bonus. Three bonus symbols across the first three reels trigger it.

You get five pots of gold and pick one to reveal a multiplier on your bet, up to 559x. That's it – one reveal, no free spins. Medium volatility, 96.07% RTP. About as simple as a modern slot gets, ideal for a quick demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
